items.name: Bare hands
items.desc: Free, and always with you.

items.name: Teeth
items.desc: A wolf's jaws.

items.name: Tusks
items.desc: A boar's tusks.

items.name: Dagger
items.desc: A plain iron knife with a bone grip. Every Gaul carries one.

items.name: Gallic long sword
items.desc: A long slashing blade, made for swinging from above. Caesar's men call them soft. Caesar's men have not been hit by one.

items.name: Roman short sword
items.desc: Short, pointed, ugly. Made for stabbing from behind a shield, which is all the Romans want to do.

items.name: Woodsman's axe
items.desc: Built for oak. Works on other things.

items.name: Spear
items.desc: An ash shaft and a leaf-shaped head. Reaches past a friend's shoulder.

items.name: Broad-bladed war spear
items.desc: A long blade with wavy edges, meant to open men up. Needs both hands.

items.name: Club
items.desc: Oak, knotted. The oldest argument.

items.name: Walking staff
items.desc: A shepherd's staff. Shepherds know how to use them.

items.name: Javelin
items.desc: A light throwing spear. Thrown, it's gone until you pick it up again.

items.name: Pilum
items.desc: A Roman throwing spear with a long soft-iron neck. It bends when it hits a shield and won't come out. That is the point.

items.name: Sling
items.desc: Two cords and a pouch. A good slinger can kill a man at a hundred paces. You may not be a good slinger.

items.name: Hunting bow
items.desc: A yew self bow, made for deer.

items.name: Sling stones
items.desc: Smooth river stones, chosen for weight.

items.name: Arrows
items.desc: Goose-fletched, iron-tipped.

items.name: Round shield
items.desc: Wicker and hide on a wooden frame.

items.name: Gallic long shield
items.desc: A tall oval of planks under leather, with an iron boss. Covers a man from chin to knee.

items.name: Roman scutum
items.desc: Curved, heavy, layered plywood with a boss. A wall you carry.

items.name: Leather jerkin
items.desc: Thick oxhide, stitched and oiled.

items.name: Padded linen coat
items.desc: Many layers of linen glued and quilted. Stops more than you'd think.

items.name: Mail shirt
items.desc: Thousands of riveted rings. Even the Romans admit the Gauls invented it.

items.name: War-chief's mail
items.desc: Fine riveted mail with shoulder doubling and bronze clasps. A noble's fortune worn on the body.

items.name: Leather cap
items.desc: Better than hair.

items.name: Iron helmet
items.desc: A Gallic iron cap with a ridge round the base, cheek pieces and a short guard at the back of the neck.

items.name: Bronze helmet
items.desc: A rounded cap with a knob on top and cheek pieces. Romans wear the same kind, copied from the Gauls.

items.name: Raven-crested helmet
items.desc: An iron cap with a bronze bird on the crown, its wings hinged. Older than anyone's grandfather; the kind of thing that comes out of a sanctuary pit or a chief's grave. Men will remember who wore this.

items.name: Healing herbs
items.desc: Yarrow, plantain, comfrey. Chewed and packed into a wound. Works better if you know what you're doing.

items.name: Linen bandages
items.desc: Clean strips of linen. Rare enough.

items.name: Druid's poultice
items.desc: A paste of mistletoe and things the druids won't name. It stings like fire and closes wounds overnight.

items.name: Barley bread
items.desc: Dense, sour, filling.

items.name: Mead
items.desc: Honey wine. Courage in a horn.

items.name: Amphora of Roman wine
items.desc: Italian red, sealed with pitch. In Gaul a jar of this has bought a slave. Some Gallic nobles drink it undiluted, to the horror of the Romans.

items.name: Cake of salt
items.desc: Grey salt from the evaporation pans. Meat that lasts the winter.

items.name: Bronze torque
items.desc: A neck ring of twisted bronze. Not gold, but it shines.

items.name: Gold torque
items.desc: A heavy twisted ring of gold. The kind of thing a man gives to the gods, or is buried in.

items.name: Picks and hooks
items.desc: Bronze picks and an iron hook in a leather roll. Adds to your Locks skill when carried.

items.name: Wolf pelt
items.desc: Grey and thick. Winter fur.

items.name: Hostage tally
items.desc: A notched tally stick with Roman letters burned into it: the receipt Brigodunon got for its children five years ago. Three notches. One is your sibling.

items.name: Elder's iron ring
items.desc: Vellaunos's ring. Shown to the Cadurci, it says you speak for Brigodunon.

items.name: Grain promise
items.desc: A cut hazel stick, the other half of which is held by the headwoman of Vindomagos. Twenty sacks of grain, to be carried across the Oltis.

items.name: Forged Roman order
items.desc: A wax tablet in good Latin, promising pardon and back pay to any deserter of the auxiliary horse who reports to the depot at Noviodunum. Entirely false.

items.name: Wooden idol
items.desc: A figure carved from a single oak root, black with age and handling. The eyes are two iron nails.

items.name: Pay tablet
items.desc: A wax tablet from the horse leader's saddlebag: a pay chit for a decurion of auxiliary horse, stamped with a Roman depot mark.

items.name: Wax tablets
items.desc: Three beech-wood tablets bound with a thong, the wax inside scratched close with Roman cursive. A seal on the binding: a running boar and the letters A VET C.

items.name: King's token
items.desc: Half of a bronze coin cut with a chisel, threaded on a cord. Ollognatos keeps the other half. Shown to the king's men, it says the bearer goes where they like.

items.name: Amphora of wine
items.desc: A full Italian amphora, its stopper sealed with pitch and stamped by a Campanian potter. In Gaul, the price of a slave. Traders say it the other way round.
